chunks.head: lo and behold
chunks.gloss: 瞧；你猜怎么着（引出意外之事）
chunks.note: 旧式固定表达，用来引出出人意料的结果，带戏剧化口吻。

literal.note_cn: 古语感叹词，几乎只用于此搭配

chunks.ex_en: I opened the old box and, lo and behold, it was full of gold coins.
chunks.ex_cn: 我打开那只旧箱子，你猜怎么着，里面装满了金币。

chunks.head: find out
chunks.note: 指经过打听、调查后得知某事，强调“弄清楚”。

literal.note_cn: find的过去式，此处指弄清、得知

chunks.ex_en: I called the shop to find out if they were still open.
chunks.ex_cn: 我打电话到店里，想弄清楚他们是否还在营业。

chunks.head: become of
chunks.gloss: （某人/某事）会怎么样；落得什么下场
chunks.note: 常用于 what will/is to become of...，表示对某人前途或结局的担忧。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“落得…下场、发生…情况”

chunks.ex_en: What will become of the puppy if no one takes it home?
chunks.ex_cn: 要是没人把这只小狗带回家，它会怎么样呢？

chunks.head: make a fool of oneself
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式（make such a fool of myself），故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: He made a fool of himself by singing loudly and off-key.
chunks.ex_cn: 他大声唱歌又跑调，出尽了洋相。

chunks.head: hang one's head
chunks.note: 表示因惭愧、难过而垂头。
chunks.ex_en: The boy hung his head when the teacher asked who broke the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师问是谁打碎了窗户时，男孩低下了头。

chunks.head: laugh at
chunks.note: 指拿某人或某事取乐，含贬义。
chunks.ex_en: Don't laugh at people who make mistakes.

chunks.head: all the way
chunks.gloss: 大老远地；一路（强调全程或远距离）
chunks.note: 强调从头到尾或路途遥远。
chunks.ex_en: She walked all the way home in the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 她冒着雨一路走回了家。

chunks.head: mean to do sth
chunks.note: mean 此处意为“打算、故意”，常用 didn't mean to 表示“不是有意的”。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“意思”，指有意去做

chunks.ex_en: I'm sorry—I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
chunks.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意要伤你的心。

chunks.head: can't bear to do sth
chunks.gloss: 不忍心做；受不了做（某事）
chunks.note: bear 此处意为“忍受”；本章 couldn't 与 bear 被 somehow 隔开，故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: She can't bear to throw away her grandmother's old letters.
chunks.ex_cn: 她不忍心扔掉祖母的那些旧信。

chunks.head: run off
chunks.ex_en: The dog ran off the moment I opened the gate.
chunks.ex_cn: 我一打开门，狗就跑掉了。

chunks.head: cover up
chunks.note: 本章指弥补、遮掩过错；也常指隐瞒真相。
chunks.ex_en: He told a lie to cover up his mistake.
chunks.ex_cn: 他撒了个谎来掩盖自己的错误。

chunks.head: keep mum
chunks.note: mum 意为“不作声的”；keep mum 指对某事绝口不提。本章 Tom 把树皮塞回口袋、什么都没说。
chunks.ex_en: Promise me you'll keep mum about the surprise party.
chunks.ex_cn: 答应我，惊喜派对的事你要守口如瓶。
